470 tables · 264,098 cells · LLM-transcribed · JSON · Excel ☰ Contents

朝鮮總督府統計年報 1939

Chōsen Sōtokufu tōkei nenpō (Statistical Annual of the Government-General of Korea), 昭和十四年 (Shōwa 14), published 1941
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1941 (昭和十六年三月刊行)

All tables are transcribed, including the summary boxes on the chapter title pages and the appendix of weights and measures; the contents pages and the 凡例 are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one; a few very long tables were read in sections by different readers and joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted, as are a few printed numbering errors (tables 88 and 89 are headed 103 and 104 in the book; table 168 is listed in the contents without a title or page). Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. About 160 of some 245,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?. Two spot checks, in which a second model re-transcribed six tables independently, agreed on 99.8% of figure cells.
